x: During the past months, however, we were fortunate in securing the services of a Continental coach, Herr F. Stampfl, whose vivacious enthusiasm and expert knowledge soon endeared him to our members.

This is one of the finest ways in which a sprinter can keep fit during the Winter. I have encouraged cross-country running for sprinters for several seasons past, and now the famous coach to the Club, Herr.

The Club has engaged Herr Stampfl to conduct an exercise class at Belgrave Hall on Wednesdays at 7-30 p.m. The exercises are designed not only for keeping fit, but to educate oneself to achieve greater athletic efficiency.
Our Field Events men have been training under F. Stampfl during the Winter, and their performance next Summer will be watched with hope and interest by all.
